questions.markdown: A single-phase motor operating at **50 Hz** draws a current of **20 A** at a **0.75 lagging power factor** from a **230 V** sinusoidal supply. Obtain the required capacitance to be connected in parallel to improve the power factor to **0.9 lagging**. Also, determine the new supply current.

A balanced **star-connected** load with a per-phase impedance of $(20 + j\ 50)\Omega$ is supplied by a **3-phase, 400 V, 50 Hz** balanced source in **RYB** sequence. Using $V_{RY}$ as the reference phasor, calculate the currents in each line, the power factor, the power consumed, the reactive VA, and the total VA.

In a delta-connected load supplied by a **3-phase, 220 V, 50 Hz AC** source, the two-wattmeter method of power measurement yields readings of **1560 W** and **2100 W**. Calculate the following:

i) Power factor of the load

ii) Line current drawn from the source

iii) Active power, reactive and apparent power of the system
